title: Statistical genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for STATISTICAL/data-report documents (NCES digests, statistical abstracts, indicator reports). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to.
$comment: Grounds the nces_digest gold source (docs/architecture/block-ontology.md § B 8), which previously degraded to Layer-1-only; pairs with the NEW L1 "chart" kind (data visualizations distinct from figure). Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.

x-roles.label: Table title
x-roles.description: The numbered title line of a statistical table ("Table 203.10. ...").

x-roles.label: Source note
x-roles.description: A SOURCE line crediting the data origin.

x-roles.label: Methodology note
x-roles.description: A NOTE line on methodology, definitions, or data caveats.

x-roles.label: Data highlight
x-roles.description: A narrative prose summary of a key statistic or trend.

x-roles.label: Data description
x-roles.description: The accessibility data description of a chart — the prose/tabular rendering of the encoded values.
